dialogue.speaker: HU3
dialogue.text: Whoa. Okay. THIS is a proper island. Beach town, hills, a whole mountain... and is that a causeway east?

dialogue.speaker: Inke
dialogue.text: One way to find out. Where do we start?

dialogue.speaker: HU3
dialogue.text: Locals first - the folks with the ! over their heads have work. CRED opens doors around here. The buoys mark safe water. Past them... don't. Sharks.
